title: alyssum alpestre var. jordani
intro: Alyssum alpestre var. jordani, commonly known as Jordan's alyssum, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions. The health benefits of Jordan's alyssum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing coughs and relieving anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
